answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh random challenge whose correct response depends on its full interaction history. A clone replaying its origin's history answers identically, so it cannot pass a challenge the origin hasn't seen; a juniper node relays only challenges its own lineage solved. Colluding twins that pre-share answers expose a shared raven trajectory, letting the verifier flag the pair. The yarrow ledger records divergence proofs, and every flagged clone costs the attacker a full re-solve of the lineage's history.
